name: OpenAPI Decoupled toolbox
description: OpenAPI support for the Decoupled toolbox module.
project_description: OpenAPI Decoupled toolbox is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox (package Web Services). It generates OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for Decoupled Toolbox endpoints. It defines a config entity `openapi_decoupled_toolbox` (fields: entity_type, bundle[], display[]) describing which entity type/bundles/displays to document, provides OpenAPI generator plugins (DecoupledToolboxGenerator / DecoupledToolboxRestGenerator) and a deriver, an admin settings form and entity CRUD UI, a menu block plugin, and an event subscriber. Browse the generated spec with openapi_ui (Swagger UI / ReDoc). Requires the contrib OpenAPI module (>=8.x-2.0-rc1) and applies a patch to it via composer.
